description: Main window, the smallest permission set: listening to menu/file events (platform-tauri.js event.listen), the native confirm dialog (dialog ask/confirm/message all use the message command) and the app's own file/backup commands (src-tauri/src/files.rs, backup.rs, i18n.rs, print.rs; JS gives no path, only an id). No core:default; no fs plug-in.
